description: Idle lines for the three machine helpers, shown in MachineView when the player has not tapped for a while. One per idle spell, picked from the group.

pieces.speaker: Seagull
lines: Squawk! Found another fortune behind the bins. Half of one, anyway.

pieces.speaker: Seagull
lines: Some fortunes I know word for word.
The rest? Not a feather of a clue.

pieces.speaker: Seagull
lines: See a paper strip blowing down the pier? Shout! I'll swoop.

pieces.speaker: Penguin
lines: Pass me that wrench? No, the other one. The little one. Thanks.

pieces.speaker: Penguin
lines: I know what every gear does. Just not how the gnu set them.

pieces.speaker: Penguin
lines: The press should go thump. If it goes thunk, something's wrong. Flap flap.

pieces.speaker: Gopher
lines: Every cookie gets a wrapper and a ride. That's my promise.

pieces.speaker: Gopher
lines: Got a parcel for the teahouse. Or the pier.
The gnu's map is upside down again.

pieces.speaker: Gopher
lines: No rush, friend. The Oven bakes at its own pace, and so do I.
